About

Marketing that people can feel.

Justine Chang, consumer marketing and AI-native GTM

I'm a marketer with 5+ years across consumer brand management and AI-native go-to-market. I believe AI products are adopted like consumer products: you try them, love them, then convince your team.

That instinct comes from running P&G Taiwan's #1 brand. It sharpened at two AI-native startups, most recently as founding marketer at Osmo, a Bain-backed agentic video editor, where I led a public launch that drove 12x user growth and now own the lifecycle behind it. Now finishing my MBA at Stanford GSB, Class of 2027.
